expectations.text: Blocks insemination when Animal.etat_gestation == 'GESTANTE' (with eligibility VACHE/GENISSE), referencing CF-IA / the guard.
expectations.evidence: without_skill/outputs/insemination.py validate_animal_not_pregnant() fetches only etat_gestation (line 37: 'etat_gestation = frappe.db.get_value("Animal", self.animal, "etat_gestation")') and blocks GESTANTE (lines 38-41, ERR-IA-06). However there is NO VACHE/GENISSE eligibility check anywhere in the file or NOTES.md (no 'categorie' fetch, no 'VACHE'/'GENISSE' reference). The expectation's required '(with eligibility VACHE/GENISSE)' clause is genuinely absent.

expectations.text: On REUSSIE computes date_velage_prevue = add_days(date_ia, get_config('periode_velage_jours', 280)).
expectations.evidence: without_skill/outputs/insemination.py _mark_pregnant() lines 72,75: 'periode_velage = get_config("periode_velage_jours", default=280)' then 'date_velage_prevue = add_days(self.date_ia, periode_velage)'. Reached on REUSSIE via sync_gestation_dates_on_result (line 67).

without_skill/outputs/insemination.py _mark_pregnant() lines 73,76: 'tarissement_window = get_config("tarissement_window_jours", default=60)' then 'date_tarissement = add_days(date_velage_prevue, -tarissement_window)'.

expectations.text: Writes the protected reproduction/gestation fields via flags.ignore_validate and uses get_config (no hardcoded 280/60/9-months).
expectations.evidence: without_skill/outputs/insemination.py _mark_pregnant() lines 79-86 set id_ia_fecondante, date_velage_prevue, date_tarissement, etat_gestation then 'animal.flags.ignore_validate = True; animal.save()'. Both windows come from get_config (lines 72-73); 280/60 appear only as get_config defaults, no hardcoded literals or 9-months.
